SwarmIntelligence_PhysarumColony.inherited: From Boolean_Works: Which leaves the honest version of what these three halls demonstrate, and it is not the one the labels promise. A solid is a lie told by its skin, and so is its hole. The grammar that carves has no word for *partly*, no word for *becoming*, and nothing to put inside the thing it cuts. Every absence in this chapter is performed rather than found — by inversion, by omission, by parity, by a caption. What you can walk through, you were always going to walk through.
SwarmIntelligence_PhysarumColony.question: Can a path remember which way to grow when no individual holds the whole network?
SwarmIntelligence_PhysarumColony.ontology: An agent is a moving state; a field stores numbers over cells. Here deposited trail changes what later agents sense: environmental memory.
SwarmIntelligence_PhysarumColony.experiment: Watch a bright connection and keep it in view when the anchor arrangement changes automatically; wait at least one 20-second transition.
SwarmIntelligence_PhysarumColony.observe: The caption cycles triad, ring, pair, scattered; trail concentrations change and fade rather than being one pre-drawn network.
SwarmIntelligence_PhysarumColony.limit: A simulated trail is not proof of a shortest route or a biological nervous system. Chosen anchors and boundary conditions determine which networks can appear.
SwarmIntelligence_PhysarumColony.variation: Existing passive variation: compare two automatic anchor layouts. Proposed: visitor-grabbable anchors or a pause control; neither is currently exposed.
SwarmIntelligence_PhysarumColony.handoff: The next room supplies directions from outside the population. Similar collective motion will have a different source.

SwarmIntelligence_FlowFields.question: If many agents turn together, must they be watching one another?
SwarmIntelligence_FlowFields.ontology: A vector field assigns a direction to a position; an integration field records costs to a target. An agent can navigate by reading its local direction.
SwarmIntelligence_FlowFields.experiment: Follow one arrow and one agent through the automatic tour: open field, block, U-wall, zigzag, wind, noise.
SwarmIntelligence_FlowFields.observe: Obstacles reorganize the arrow pattern; wind has a direction without a destination. The tour advances every10s and remains in noise at the end.
SwarmIntelligence_FlowFields.limit: Common motion can come from shared infrastructure rather than agreement. Cost maps choose what counts as a traversable route.
SwarmIntelligence_FlowFields.variation: Existing comparison: observe the tour. Proposed: hide arrows while holding a scenario fixed using curator scenario/field_display configuration; visitor VR wall placement is not implemented.
SwarmIntelligence_FlowFields.handoff: Boids will remove that supplied direction and let nearby agents become one another’s moving reference.

SwarmIntelligence_Boids_Algorithm.inherited: From SwarmIntelligence_FlowFields: Boids will remove that supplied direction and let nearby agents become one another’s moving reference.
SwarmIntelligence_Boids_Algorithm.question: Which local relationship is making this flock hold together?
SwarmIntelligence_Boids_Algorithm.ontology: Separation, alignment and cohesion are distinct steering contributions; weights determine their relative influence on an agent velocity.
SwarmIntelligence_Boids_Algorithm.experiment: Follow the highlighted boid and its coloured force arrows. Change one SEP, ALIGN or COH slider while leaving the other settings alone.
SwarmIntelligence_Boids_Algorithm.observe: The highlighted agent exposes red separation, blue alignment and green cohesion; population motion changes as one contribution gains weight.
SwarmIntelligence_Boids_Algorithm.limit: A flock pattern cannot establish consent or a universal ideal balance. The boundary wraps and the neighbour radius already decide who is in relation.
SwarmIntelligence_Boids_Algorithm.variation: Existing: alter perception RADIUS, then see whether the same rule weights still make the same group. Proposed: asymmetric perception to test whose movements become visible.
SwarmIntelligence_Boids_Algorithm.handoff: The next room broadens the model: an agent can have an internal state, and the environment can remember what it did.

SwarmIntelligence_Agent_Based_Modeling_A.inherited: From SwarmIntelligence_Boids_Algorithm: The next room broadens the model: an agent can have an internal state, and the environment can remember what it did.
SwarmIntelligence_Agent_Based_Modeling_A.question: How much of a collective result changes when one rule changes?
SwarmIntelligence_Agent_Based_Modeling_A.ontology: An agent-based model stores individual states and update rules; population outcomes are produced by repeated interaction with shared state.
SwarmIntelligence_Agent_Based_Modeling_A.experiment: Watch the colony, raise EVAPORATE, and compare trail persistence; use RESET before a second comparison. MODE cycles the displayed behavioural mode.
SwarmIntelligence_Agent_Based_Modeling_A.observe: The trail heatmap loses or retains marks at different rates. ANTS changes population between5and80 and respawns the agents.
SwarmIntelligence_Agent_Based_Modeling_A.limit: An aggregate picture does not validate the agents as models of people. What agents can sense and what the shared grid remembers are design choices.
SwarmIntelligence_Agent_Based_Modeling_A.variation: Existing: compare many short-lived traces with fewer lasting traces using ANTS and EVAPORATE separately. Proposed: agents with differing sensor capacities.
SwarmIntelligence_Agent_Based_Modeling_A.handoff: The next colony makes one relation particularly clear: information about home and food travels in different channels.

SwarmIntelligence_Ant_Colony_Optimizatio.inherited: From SwarmIntelligence_Agent_Based_Modeling_ABM: The next colony makes one relation particularly clear: information about home and food travels in different channels.
SwarmIntelligence_Ant_Colony_Optimizatio.question: How can an ant leave useful directions without carrying a map?
SwarmIntelligence_Ant_Colony_Optimizatio.ontology: Stigmergy coordinates activity through a shared medium. This colony uses two numerical trail channels: home and food.
SwarmIntelligence_Ant_Colony_Optimizatio.experiment: Observe ants leaving the centre and returning from either food anchor. Compare fresh bright trails with areas no longer visited.
SwarmIntelligence_Ant_Colony_Optimizatio.observe: Ants change direction/state on reaching food or home, with trail information persisting in the ground between visits.
SwarmIntelligence_Ant_Colony_Optimizatio.limit: This scene is a spatial foraging model, not a demonstrated travelling-salesman solver. Efficient-looking trails alone do not prove global optimality.
SwarmIntelligence_Ant_Colony_Optimizatio.variation: Existing: compare the two fixed food directions. Proposed: curator anchorage ring/triad/scattered variants or movablefood; there is no visitor food-layout control in this scene.
SwarmIntelligence_Ant_Colony_Optimizatio.handoff: Particle swarms next move memory into each agent’s best position and a best position shared by the population.

SwarmIntelligence_Particle_Swarm_Optimiz.inherited: From SwarmIntelligence_Ant_Colony_Optimization: Particle swarms next move memory into each agent’s best position and a best position shared by the population.
SwarmIntelligence_Particle_Swarm_Optimiz.question: When a swarm improves, who decided what better means?
SwarmIntelligence_Particle_Swarm_Optimiz.ontology: A particle keeps its own best position and follows a swarm best; fitness is the scoring rule that names these positions best.
SwarmIntelligence_Particle_Swarm_Optimiz.experiment: Watch CONVERGE, then press SPREAD, then NOVELTY. Keep INERTIA fixed during the comparison.
SwarmIntelligence_Particle_Swarm_Optimiz.observe: The same kind of moving population collects toward the centre, favours distance from it, or seeks distance from archived positions according to the chosen score.
SwarmIntelligence_Particle_Swarm_Optimiz.limit: Optimization inherits its purpose from the objective; a high score cannot establish that a social outcome is desirable. Novelty also depends on what the archive remembers.
SwarmIntelligence_Particle_Swarm_Optimiz.variation: Existing: choose novelty as the primary aim instead of treating dispersal as failure; then vary INERTIA. Proposed: compare two explicit conflicting objectives simultaneously.
SwarmIntelligence_Particle_Swarm_Optimiz.handoff: The capstone turns from declared objectives to quieter rules that keep an apparently self-organising system alive.

SwarmIntelligence_Swarm_Intelligence_Alg.inherited: From SwarmIntelligence_Particle_Swarm_Optimization: The capstone turns from declared objectives to quieter rules that keep an apparently self-organising system alive.
SwarmIntelligence_Swarm_Intelligence_Alg.question: If this small ecosystem persists, which rules are helping it persist?
SwarmIntelligence_Swarm_Intelligence_Alg.ontology: A population is coupled to resources, predation and reproduction. A simulation may include a separate stabilizer as well as individual agent rules.
SwarmIntelligence_Swarm_Intelligence_Alg.experiment: Read the Prey, Pred and Food counts, then track a food loss or population change before returning to the counts.
SwarmIntelligence_Swarm_Intelligence_Alg.observe: Population and food counts change; prey seek food/flee predators and predators seek prey. The simulation also restocks agents under explicit thresholds.
SwarmIntelligence_Swarm_Intelligence_Alg.limit: Persistence is not evidence of self-regulation alone: a coded referee assists it. This room contains one ecosystem artifact, not the multi-algorithm showcase imagined in old intent.
SwarmIntelligence_Swarm_Intelligence_Alg.variation: Existing: distinguish agent events from count changes plausibly due to restocking. Proposed: compare curator quota fallow/barren/hunted configurations or expose restocking as a visitor control.
SwarmIntelligence_Swarm_Intelligence_Alg.handoff: Machine learning begins by asking what changes across generations. Carry this distinction with you: inherited traits, environmental rewards and the rules that keep an experiment running all shape what can survive.
